attributes.description: Monitor Elastic Workflows executions, failures, success rates, and duration with ES|QL.

query.esql:
FROM .workflows-executions
| WHERE startedAt >= ?_tstart AND startedAt < ?_tend
| WHERE (?space_ids IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(spaceId, ?space_ids)) AND (?run_types IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(CASE(COALESCE(isTestRun, false), "test", "production"), ?run_types))
| STATS executions = COUNT(*)

FROM .workflows-executions
| WHERE startedAt >= ?_tstart AND startedAt < ?_tend
| WHERE (?space_ids IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(spaceId, ?space_ids)) AND (?run_types IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(CASE(COALESCE(isTestRun, false), "test", "production"), ?run_types))
| STATS executions = COUNT(*)

| WHERE startedAt >= ?_tstart AND startedAt < ?_tend
| WHERE (?space_ids IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(spaceId, ?space_ids)) AND (?run_types IS NULL OR MV_INTERSECTS(CASE(COALESCE(isTestRun, false), "test", "production"), ?run_types))
| STATS total = COUNT(*) WHERE status IN ("completed", "failed", "cancelled", "timed_out", "skipped"), completed = COUNT(*) WHERE status == "completed"
| EVAL success_rate = CASE(total > 0, TO_DOUBLE(completed) / total, 0.0)
| KEEP success_rate
